name: Jiro
summary: Library of 1,200+ website section and full-page template designs, each with a copy-paste prompt for AI builders.
description: A design prompt library organised by section type — headers, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, footer, CTA, stats, team, contact — plus full-page landing page templates for agency, portfolio, e-commerce, fintech, real estate and other categories. Browse a design, copy its prompt into Bolt, Lovable, v0, Cursor or Claude Code, or connect the MCP server at mcp.jiro.build to pull sections directly into an editor.
contains: 1,162 section components and 110 full-page templates (1,272 in total)
counts: features 237, navbar/header 197, testimonials 114, footers 106, FAQ 84, pricing 70, stats 32, CTAs 28, team 18
each item: live preview, tags, a prompt to copy, and React/Tailwind code via MCP
MCP server (mcp.jiro.build) works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, Bolt, VS Code
template categories: agency, portfolio, e-commerce, fintech, real estate, health, media, education, travel
